A group of companies, a bank or city services come together in one app: customers sign up once and pay everywhere. An MVP in 16–24 weeks, from UZS 600 mln; the full version in 36–60 weeks.

What you get

Questions

What does “Super app: many services in one app” cost?
The MVP costs $50,000–100,000 (UZS 600–1,205 mln), the full version $150,000–400,000 (UZS 1,800–4,805 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Super app: many services in one app” take?
The MVP takes 16–24 weeks, the full version 36–60 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
App Store and Google Play accounts; Logo, colours and texts; One person who makes the decisions.
